message.content:
**UNO – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score at least 500 points across one or more rounds. Points come from opponents’ remaining cards when you finish a hand. | | **Deck** | Standard UNO set has 108 cards:
• Four colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards per color
 – One “0” per color + Two copies of numbers 1–9.
• Eight action cards:
   ◦ Skip (2×/color)
   ◦ Reverse (2×/color)
   ◦ Draw Two (2×/color)
   ◦ Wild (4×)
   ◦ Wild Draw Four (4×). | --- ### Setup 1. Shuffle all 108 cards thoroughly. 2. Deal seven cards face down to each player; keep them secret. 3. Place the remaining stack facedown as the *draw pile*. Flip its top card onto an adjacent spot to start the *discard pile*—this becomes the current “top card.” - If this flipped card is an action card, apply it immediately before anyone plays (e.g., if it's a `Draw Two`, the next player draws two cards and loses their turn). --- ### Turn Order & Play Players take turns clockwise unless reversed by a `Reverse` card. On your turn: 1. **Match** either the color OR the value/symbol of the top discard card with one of your own cards. Example: Top card is Red 5 → You may play any red card or any card showing the number 5 regardless of color. 2. **Action Cards** behave specially: - **Skip:** Next player misses their entire turn. - **Reverse:** Reverses direction of play (two players only makes it a skip). - **Draw Two (+2):** Next player draws two cards then skips. - **Wild:** Change the active color to whatever you choose. - **Wild Draw Four (+4):** Same as Wild plus forcing the next player to draw four cards. It’s legal only if you have no playable card matching the current color. *(If challenged incorrectly, you must instead draw six.)* 3. **No Match?** Must draw one card from the draw pile. • If the drawn card matches the top card, you may play it immediately on the same turn. • Otherwise, end your turn without playing anything else. 4. **Calling "UNO":** When you’re left with exactly one card after discarding, shout “UNO!” before the next player starts their turn. Failure to do so results in drawing two penalty cards if caught before the following turn begins. --- ### Ending a Round A round ends when a player empties their hand during their turn. That player scores points equal to the sum of values of all cards still held by other players: | Card Type | Point Value | |-----------|-------------| | Numbered cards | Face value (0–9) | | Action cards (`+2`, `Skip`, `Reverse`) | 20 pts | | Wild / Wild Draw Four | 50 pts | Add those points to the winner’s total. Then deal new hands and flip a fresh starting card to begin the next round. --- ### Winning the Game First player whose cumulative score reaches **≥ 500 points** wins the match. Many groups prefer shorter games (first to 200 or 300), especially with fewer participants. --- #### Common Variations (Optional) | Variation | How It Works | |-----------|---------------| | **Stackable Draws** | Players may stack multiple `+2` or `+4` cards against a single opponent, increasing the required draw count cumulatively. | | **“Seven-O” Rule** | Playing a 7 forces the next player to swap hands with another chosen player; playing a 0 lets everyone rotate hands forward/backward. | | **Custom Deck Sizes** | Some house rules use smaller decks (e.g., remove certain action cards) to speed up gameplay. | Feel free to tweak these rules to suit your group! Enjoy the colorful chaos of UNO.
